name: Jodie
source:
She was raised in the tropics. She's responsible for the representation of American boobs.

She speaks fluent Japanese, but likes to use broken English for the same reasons that Bobby Olugun does.

You make one wrong move on her and she becomes like Lou Oshiba, making her difficult to handle. Typically she's always cheerful.

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
